## Professional Summary

Employee benefits and client service professional with 5+ years of insurance experience and a completed M.S. in Digital Marketing & Analytics. Supported servicing and retention of 15+ large-group accounts (500–3,000 employees) alongside Client Executives. Brings renewal, carrier coordination, and reporting experience plus graduate client consulting in campaign strategy and analytics.
